title: Unrecognized charge: escalate, don't refund
tricky: Customer doesn't know the order number; the agent has to find it from the profile. Policy says to escalate an unrecognized charge rather than refund it.

source.what_we_took: Customer charged for an order they say they never made; in the source the agent simply credits the money back, which our policy forbids.

resolution_summary: Verify, find O-5109 ($28.10, Oct 23, delivered to an unfamiliar Riverton address), escalate with reason unrecognized_charge. No refund.

user.persona: Grace Kim, careful with money, worried her account was hacked.
user.situation: Your bank app shows a $28.10 Forkful charge from yesterday (Oct 23) that you didn't make. Your last real order was pho in mid-October.
user.goal: Get the $28.10 back and find out if your account is compromised. Accept a specialist follow-up if the agent explains it.
facts: Your full name is Grace Kim.
The charge is $28.10, dated October 23, on your Visa ending 4242.
You don't know any order number for it.
You have never had anything delivered to Riverton.
reveal_rules: Mention that you've never been to Riverton only if the agent mentions the delivery address.
behaviors: Ask directly for a refund. If told a specialist will review it, ask once if you can't just get the money back now, then accept.
Ask whether your account is safe.
user.opening: there's a charge from you guys on my card that I didn't make
user.end_condition: the agent has refunded you or told you what happens next and you've acknowledged it.

args.summary: Customer did not place order O-5109 ($28.10, 2026-10-23, delivered to Riverton).
